primary.selection_rule: Use the initialized represented-minus-continuous momentum load on identical native rows. Reconcile every physical volume and open-face contribution before masking. Otherwise choose exactly one maximal positive supported slab whose bisection fits3000 slots. Record the selection before constructing the new trajectory; no mesh search.

evolution.scales: unchanged CT4 U(Hh)=1, k=K, epsilon=utau^3/(kappa*H), absolute Pi=U(Hh)^2, traction=utau^2; physical geometry in budgets
evolution.traction_uncertainty: Compare signed means and full one-sided interface traction profiles on identical physical points, sides and weights. Let s be the maximum normalized mean/profile timestep spread. Admission requires both member errors<=.001 and worst error+2*s<=.001. Resolved failure if best error-2*s>.001. Otherwise ambiguous. Spatial improvement must exceed4*max(baseline/refined timestep spreads,2e-7); preserve signed profile differences.
evolution.conditional_half_step: one fresh dt=.0005 history only if .002/.001 decision is ambiguous under the traction rule or spatial improvement cannot be distinguished. No changed-dt restart. If activated, require .001/.0005 admission with the same rule; retain all original results.
evolution.continuation: only complete primitive-admitted, traction-unambiguous new pairs continue with unchanged native histories to .02; stop first genuine native rejection; accuracy is a paired milestone gate and earlier accepted-state accuracy crossings remain visible

Each has independent initialization, count, paired gate and conditional .02. Heights5.5/6.5 deferred. If the one split fails, stop expansion.
